1st Year

B.Tech S1 / S2 · Common courses
S1 / S2 First & second semester · 2 subjects
Introduction to Electrical & Electronics Engineering
GXEST104
Module 1

DC & Magnetic Circuits

Ohm/KCL/KVL, C & L energy, star-delta, mesh/nodal matrices, magnetics + drills.

 Module 2

AC & Three-Phase

EMI, RMS/phasors, R/L/C, RLC resonance, power & PF, star/delta + drills.

 Module 3

Devices & Circuits

Diodes, Zener regulation, rectifiers & ripple, BJT, biasing, amplifiers, MOSFETs + drill.

 Module 4

Comms & Instruments

Comm/fibre blocks, AM/FM receivers, GSM & generations, DMM, CRO, IoT + drill.
Physics for Physical Science and Life Science
GZPHT121
Module 1

Laser & Fibre Optics

Emission processes, inversion & pumping, Ruby/CO2/diode lasers, fibre types, NA derivation, link block diagram + drills.

 Module 2

Interference & Diffraction

Superposition, thin films, Newton's rings, air wedge, single slit, grating equation, powers + mixed numerical drill.

 Module 3

Quantum Mechanics

Uncertainty + applications, wavefunction & Schrodinger equations, 1D box derivation, energy/probability drills, tunnelling.

 Module 4

Waves & Acoustics

Wave basics, stretched string + laws, Sabine reverberation + drill, piezoelectric & diffractometer, SONAR/NDT, ultrasound.

2nd Year

B.Tech S3 / S4 · Branch core + mathematics
S3 Third semester · 2 subjects
Mathematics for Information Science-3
GAMAT301
Module 1

Discrete Random Variables

pmf & cdf, expectation & variance, binomial, Poisson limit, joint pmf, functions of RVs + drill.

 Module 2

Continuous Random Variables

pdf & cdf, uniform, normal standardisation, exponential memorylessness, joint pdf + mixed drill.

 Module 3

Limit Theorems & Processes

Markov & Chebyshev bounds, SLLN & CLT approximations, counting processes, Poisson process + drills.

 Module 4

Markov Chains

Transition matrix, random walk & ruin, Chapman–Kolmogorov, classification, stationary distribution + drill.
Data Structures and Algorithms
PCCST303
Module 1

Stacks & Queues

ADTs, complexity & notations, sparse matrices, stacks, queues, expression traces + drill.

 Module 2

Linked Lists & Memory

Singly/doubly/circular lists, linked stacks & queues, fit strategies, GC & compaction + drill.

 Module 3

Trees & Graphs

Binary trees, traversals, BST, heaps, graph representation, BFS/DFS + drill.

 Module 4

Sorting & Hashing

Selection/insertion/quick/merge/heap/radix sorts, binary search, hashing + drill.

3rd Year

B.Tech S5 / S6 · Computer Science core
S5 Fifth semester · 4 subjects
Machine Learning
PCCST503
Module 1

Parameter Estimation

MLE, MAP, regression models, and mathematical foundations.

 Module 2

Supervised Learning

Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, KNN, and Decision Trees.

 Module 3

SVMs & Neural Networks

Maximum margin hyperplanes, Perceptrons, and Backpropagation.

 Module 4

Unsupervised & Ensembles

K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, PCA, Bagging, and Boosting.
Computer Networks
PCCST501
Module 1

Application Layer

Internet overview, OSI & TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, FTP, SMTP, and P2P.

 Module 2

Transport & Network Layer

TCP, UDP, Congestion Control, IPv4/IPv6, and Routing Algorithms.

 Module 3

Data Link Layer

Framing, CRC error detection, CSMA/CD, ARP, VLANs, and 802.11.

 Module 4

Physical Layer & Management

SNMP, Nyquist & Shannon limits, PCM, and Modulation techniques.
Design and Analysis of Algorithms
PCCST502
Module 1

Asymptotics & Recurrences

Complexity analysis, Master theorem, Recursion trees, and AVL trees.

 Module 2

Graphs & Divide and Conquer

Union-Find, BFS/DFS, Kosaraju SCC, Merge Sort, and Strassen.

 Module 3

Greedy, DP & Backtracking

Kruskal, Prim, Dijkstra, Matrix Chain Multiplication, and N-Queens.

 Module 4

Branch & Bound & Complexity

TSP, NP-Completeness proofs, Bin Packing, and Randomized Algorithms.
Artificial Intelligence
PECST522
Module 1

Agents & Problem Solving

PEAS framework, agent architectures, and classic AI toy problems.

 🧪 Module 1 Lab

Practice Lab: Agents & PEAS

Real-world scenario matrix, cheat tables, active recall quizzes, and KTU 7-mark model solutions.

 Module 2

Search & Game Playing

A* Search, CSPs, AC-3, Minimax, and Alpha-Beta pruning.

 Module 3

Knowledge & Logic

Wumpus World, Propositional & First-Order Logic, Unification, and Chaining.

 Module 4

Reinforcement Learning

Passive & Active RL, Q-Learning, Policy Search, and Inverse RL.
S6 Sixth semester · 8 subjects
Compiler Design
PCCST601
Module 1

Front End & Scanners

Compiler phases, regex & FSA, RE-to-scanner pipeline, Lex hands-on + drill.

 Module 2

Top-Down Parsing

Grammars & ambiguity, left recursion/factoring, recursive descent, LL(1) tables + drills.

 Module 3

Bottom-Up & IR

Shift-reduce, LR(1)/LALR, YACC, IR taxonomy, TAC, SDT + drills.

 Module 4

Codegen & Optimization

Code shapes, LVN, unrolling, liveness, placement + drill.
Advanced Computing Systems
PCCST602
Module 1

Distributed Models

HPC/HTC, IoT & CPS, multicore/GPU, clusters/grids/P2P/clouds + drill.

 Module 2

Clusters & Jobs

Availability, architecture & SSI, HA & checkpoints, scheduling, migration + drill.

 Module 3

Virtualization

Levels, VMM & containers, CPU/mem/IO techniques, live migration + drill.

 Module 4

Cloud & Containers

Cloud models & cost, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, microservices, Docker + drill.
Fundamentals of Cyber Security
PBCST604
Module 1

InfoSec & VAPT

Threats & risk, recon, buffer overflows, format strings, Burp & Metasploit + drill.

 Module 2

Web & DNS Security

SQLi, XSS, CSRF, DNSSEC, ZAP/DVWA labs, email security + drill.

 Module 3

Network Security

DoS/DDoS, ARP spoofing, sniffing tricks, Nmap, Wireshark + chain drill.

 Module 4

System Security

Windows & Linux hardening, SELinux, PBL project guide + drill.
Deep Learning (Elective)
PECST632
Module 1

MLP & Backprop

Forward pass, backprop + Adam, SGD regimes, curse of dimensionality, deep plumbing + drill.

 Module 2

Depth & Autoencoders

Representation learning, ReLU family, RBMs, autoencoders, applications + drill.

 Module 3

CNNs & RNNs

Convolutions, AlexNet/ResNet, BPTT, seq2seq, LSTM/GRU, dim drills + drill.

 Module 4

GANs & Advanced AEs

CV/speech/NLP cases, sparse/denoising/VAE/contractive AEs, GAN zoo + drills.
Fundamentals of Cryptography (Elective)
PECST637
Module 1

Number Theory

Euclid, modular arithmetic, Fermat/Euler, primitive roots, Miller–Rabin, CRT + drill.

 Module 2

Classical Ciphers

Attack models, symmetric model, substitution, transposition, Feistel + drill.

 Module 3

Modern Ciphers & RSA

DES, AES, RC4, public-key principles, RSA, Diffie–Hellman + drill.

 Module 4

Hashes & PKI

Hash grades, SHA-3, HMAC, signatures, key management, X.509 + drills.

PECST631
Module 1

Foundations

Quality, famous failures, terminology, test types, box methods, automation + drill.

 Module 2

Unit & Mutation

Static/dynamic/control-flow, data-flow, mutants & score, JUnit, AI tools + drill.

 Module 3

White-Box & Security

Graph coverage, du-paths, CFGs, design testing, OWASP/Burp + drills.

 Module 4

Black-Box & PEX

ECP/BVA, decision tables, grey-box, performance, symbolic execution + drill.
Design Thinking and Product Development
GXEST605
Module 1

Fundamentals

Lifecycle, design thinking defined, social impact, sustainability, idea self-check + drill.

 Module 2

Empathize & Define

Phases, 5 Why, empathy maps, journey maps, personas, POV + drills.

 Module 3

Ideate & PoC

Ideation tools, research, feasibility, PoC validation + drills.

 Module 4

Design to Pilot

SRD, DFMEA, prototyping, pilot build, BMC, journal guide + drill.

OECST614
Module 1

ML Basics & Regression

ML vs rules, paradigms, MLE/MAP, features & loss, single & multi-variable regression + drill.

 Module 2

Classification & Evaluation

Naive Bayes, KNN, overfitting & LASSO/RIDGE, splits, precision/recall/ROC & MAE/RMSE + drill.

 Module 3

Neural Nets & Trees

Perceptron, MLP & activations, backprop, info gain & ID3 + drills.

 Module 4

Clustering & Ensembles

Similarity & HAC, k-means, PCA, bagging/boosting, CV & bias–variance + drill.
